features.name: OpenClaw gateway daemon
features.detail: Polls Telegram getUpdates, forwards each message to the active agent. Listens 0.0.0.0:18789 (TCP). gateway.bind=lan, gateway.auth.mode=token. Hot-reloads on config change.

features.name: Gateway config
features.detail: Agent list, model defaults (ollama/gemma4:26b, gpt-oss-20b), bind/auth, controlUi.allowInsecureAuth=false (hardened 2026-06-15). Integrity-checked by Sentry.

features.name: TOOLS.md capability playbook
features.detail: 1,262-line natural-language flow registry. GLOBAL_CONTEXT_RULES_v3 permission tiers + per-capability flows mapped to shell commands. The integration point — add a section, restart gateway, capability is live.

features.name: Exec approval list
features.detail: Auto-approved shell commands the gateway may run without prompting.

features.name: WSL keepalive + port proxy
features.detail: OC-Keepalive-Service (NSSM) runs daemon every 30 min; rebuilds Windows->WSL port proxy on boot; OAuth token expiry watch (48h Telegram alert).

features.name: Permission firewall + flows
features.detail: TALK/DO/PRIVATE gate evaluation (first match wins); sender.id==260811037 => Renne (DO). Language-matched refusal templates. Appended into TOOLS.md.

features.name: Slash-command router (fallback CLI)
features.detail: route_command() maps /status /email /digest /health /briefing /hive /kakei /vip to agent scripts. Live gateway uses natural language, so retained as manual-test/fallback CLI.

features.name: Telegram poller (deprecated-on-arrival)
features.detail: Stdlib Telegram long-poller with photo/voice handlers. KEPT, do not auto-start — would 409-Conflict with the live gateway on the same bot token. Manual outage fallback only.

features.name: RSS fetch / score / cluster
features.detail: feedparser + ThreadPoolExecutor (8 workers), fuzzy de-dup via SequenceMatcher, per-category caps, category emojis. Feeds: kaze-feeds.json; policy: kaze-source-policy.json.

features.name: LLM provider router
features.detail: Central router: Cloudflare Workers AI primary / Ollama fallback (or reverse) via KAZE_LLM_PROVIDER. think=false for reasoning models; strips <think> tags. All digest scripts route through it.

features.name: Digest delivery scripts
features.detail: 4 Task Scheduler jobs at 6AM/6PM (news + AI). Telegram footer 'Prepared via Kaze | By Maia Quiddam'; archive push to NotebookLM.

features.name: Feed config REST API
features.detail: Reads/writes kaze-feeds.json + kaze-source-policy.json behind a web UI. Runs as QI_KazeConfigAPI (NSSM) at :18800/kaze-config/.

features.name: Gmail IMAP fetch
features.detail: IMAP fetch (imap.gmail.com:993) + decode -> JSON. App-password auth from ~/.openclaw/secrets/yubin-mail.env.

features.name: Classify + digest + deliver
features.detail: Orchestrator called by OC-Yubin-Daily-8AM/6PM. Classifies, summarises (via kaze-llm-provider), suppresses spam, delivers to Telegram; hooks VIP + Kakei.

features.name: VIP allowlist check
features.detail: In-pipeline VIP lane; needs ~/.openclaw/workspace-email/yubin-vip.json populated with VIP addresses/domains.

features.name: Briefing orchestrator
features.detail: Assembles 7 sections (header, calendar, news, inbox, kakei, sentry, hive). OC-Asa-Briefing-7AM. Each section degrades gracefully.

features.name: Hive health fetcher
features.detail: Calls QI Hive Brain at :9011 for ecosystem summary. Repointed from dead 9010 on 2026-06-15.

features.name: Calendar fetcher
features.detail: Code fixed 2026-06-15; requires CALENDAR_ICS_URL in ~/.openclaw/secrets/asa-calendar.env to activate.

features.name: SQLite ledger CRUD
features.detail: init/add-bill/add-expense/list-bills/mark-paid/summary subcommands. Two tables: bills + expenses. DB at ~/.openclaw/workspace-kakei/kakei.db.

features.name: Email -> ledger extractor
features.detail: Picks bill/statement/invoice-class items from Yubin's classified output and LLM-extracts amount/due-date/payee via kaze-llm-provider.

features.name: Weekly summary job
features.detail: Sunday 7PM Telegram rollup (OC-Kakei-Weekly-Sunday-7PM).

features.name: Receipt photo skill
features.detail: OCR via qwen3-vl (nlm_vision) -> kakei add-expense. Needs Tasuke photo handler wired + qwen3-vl pulled.

features.name: Speech-to-text
features.detail: ffmpeg -> 16kHz mono WAV -> whisper.cpp (small.en default); strips bracketed timestamps; returns JSON. Fully local.

features.name: Text-to-speech (edge, default)
features.detail: Per-paragraph language detection -> Microsoft neural voice (pt-BR-FranciscaNeural / en-US-JennyNeural / es / ja / fr); concatenates mixed-language audio into one Ogg/Opus.

features.name: TTS engine router
features.detail: Honours KOE_TTS_ENGINE (edge|dots|piper); dots auto-falls-back to edge if GPU service down/low-VRAM.

features.name: dots.tts GPU voice clone
features.detail: Resident systemd service on 127.0.0.1:8475 (RTX 5080, torch cu128). PARKED DISABLED — reliable EN/ZH only. Toggle via koe-dots-ctl.sh.

features.name: Daily health check
features.detail: Deterministic checks: gateway :18789, Ollama models, disk, memory, config JSON integrity, external ports, apt updates. Writes report + dashboard JSON. WSL cron 6AM.

features.name: NotebookLM auth/push check
features.detail: Verifies NotebookLM cookie + Kaze/Yubin push logs; surfaces WARNING into the daily verdict.

features.name: Weekly drift check
features.detail: Reads C:/QIH/engine/hive/inspector/reports/compliance-YYYY-MM-DD.json. OC-Sentry-Drift-Sunday-8PM; exits 0 if reports absent.

features.name: QI Hive bridge skill
features.detail: status/project/pending/decisions/ask subcommands against QI Brain at :9011 (env QI_BRAIN_URL). Fixed 2026-06-15.

features.name: Cross-bot peer bridge
features.detail: HMAC-SHA256 signed POSTs of Telegram-shaped synthetic updates between bots (shared-chats.json). Receiver RUNNING; quiet-mode + panic-button + LINE handoff.

features.name: Bot-to-bot loop guard
features.detail: Per-chat exchange counter + cooldown; any human message resets it. Prevents infinite bot-war loops. Called before replying to friendly bots.

features.name: Broadcast pusher
features.detail: Proactive multi-group send with group validation + forward-metadata auto-register. Tasks OC-Broadcast-News + OC-Broadcast-Tick DISABLED until wanted.

features.name: NotebookLM client + vision
features.detail: Cookie-auth notebooklm-py client + Playwright/qwen3-vl vision layer to drive UI-only features (Generate Audio/Summary) with no Google API. Cookie copied to runtime every 30 min (cron).

features.name: Dashboard static server
features.detail: Node http server on 127.0.0.1:18800 serving runtime/dashboard (agents, tasks, roadmap, sentry-latest, seiri panels). Directory-traversal guard.
